admission.justification: Grant machinery must not change the existing enclosed leaf and master publication answers.

applicability: Enclosed leaf and master closeout preview, apply and integration operation-response parity.
conditions: For every named phase, compare raw current pristine/unrelated-grant answers after only the explicit volatility/root scrub before any take-out.

The baseline-only subprocess maps its own leaf_preview/leaf_apply written, unchanged and staleIndexes facts to refreshedCount, unchangedCount and staleCount; it has no current/grant result available to copy.

The existing conversion-marker row/count/gate scaffolding is separately attributed, and only the four named removed seat fields are taken from the baseline side. Current route-index count keys are not removed; every other field and the original post-normalization equality assertions remain.
exclusions: Raw timestamps, root paths and other scrubbed values are not claimed byte-identical.
A direct granted leaf is outside this preservation comparison.

Unqualified raw baseline byte equality: the named conversion, baseline-only four-seat-field removal and baseline producer count-shape mapping qualify the comparison; generic metadata suppression and alteration of product answers are excluded.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_no_grant_closeout_parity.py::NoGrantCloseoutParityTest::test_before_after_implementation_parity (baseline git-archive 228fd5ca guarded pre-grant vs pristine vs unrelated-grant, six exact responses scrub-equal); worker journal R4 section; R5 verdict 88c054160ffdffef415a01cdf0f09161bb59aa68944469379856e72944c46755

statement: Ordinary enclosed leaf/master preview, apply and integration answers are grant-inert: current pristine and unrelated-grant responses compare equal after the explicit volatility/root scrub before any adaptation; the pre-change baseline compares equal to both after the named conversion and baseline-only removed-seat-field adaptation, with its own leaf route-index facts mapped to the current count shape by the baseline producer. No route-index counts are suppressed in current answers.
